plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first building phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan with one short S&C session per week. Week 1 is used to establish a baseline on the primary squat lift, and the main training starts in Week 2. With only 30 minutes per session, the plan keeps the focus tight: explosive lower-body power first, then simple full-body strength, then brief trunk work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple explosive qualities with low exercise count and clean technique.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Raise force output on the main lifts while keeping some fast jumping and throwing work in place.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Convert the stronger base into sharper, faster power with lower fatigue and higher movement speed.
